title: Use chat when the interaction is dialogue, not as a default shell
problemCues: Adding an AI assistant to a working SaaS screen; temptation to wrap the app in a chat sidebar
preconditions: Task objects exist outside the transcript
decision: Choose topology before components. Prefer shared working material with conversation as a modality. Reach for chat when the interaction genuinely is turn-taking dialogue. Do not treat anti-chat guidance as a ban on Alexis conversation.
tradeoffs: Chat is familiar but hides structure; structured workspaces need more design
exceptions: Support troubleshooting and open-ended Q&A where the transcript is the artifact
example: Alexis chart workspace with optional transcript
validatedBy: Diagnosis names topology choice; chat-only shells fail multimodal continuity briefs
